new_claims.statement: For two literal physical hubs and a disjoint leaf bank with diagonal-plus-rank-r curvature, positive mixed Gram G and all normalized mixed leverages <=1/2, the full quadratic law has continuous density bounded by C_r [det(G) prod|lambda_k|]^(-1/(r+4)), C_r=4(r+4)/(r+2)2^(-4/(r+4)), uniformly in the arbitrary physical 2x2 hub core and arbitrary conditioned outside blocks; the same coefficient gives a linear interval estimate.
If the S union T leaf block is diagonal plus epsilon q q^T, then for the literal hub pair a,b the partner anchored physical third volume satisfies V_ab(S)=||q_S||_2^2 det Gram(q_T,A[T,a],A[T,b]).

Under the rank-one-plus-diagonal leaf hypothesis and mixed-frame leverage gate, ||p_Q||inf <=(5/3)2^(6/5) det(G_T)^(-1/5)=(5/3)2^(6/5)(||q_S||^2/V_ab(S))^(1/5), independently of the physical pair core, hence uniformly across its rank/sign strata.
